title: Two modes, five skins
summary: One content tree. The mode picks the shell; the theme picks the tokens.

blocks.title: Two modes, five skins
blocks.body: The same content file feeds both modes. Only the shell changes.

columns.name: Present - for driving the room
columns.detail: One section per screen, big type, arrow keys and swipe, a small position counter. Auto-advance stays off.

columns.name: Read - for opening a link
columns.detail: A normal scrolling page with section anchors. Natural on a phone, so shared links open here by default.

items.label: mode shells, never two content trees

blocks.heading: Five style presets, not five apps
items: Shop floor - dark charcoal and safety orange; sparse and practical.
Glass brief - frosted panels and cool neutrals; a consulting leave-behind.
Poster - huge type, two or three colors, full-bleed sections.
Editorial - long-read rhythm and quiet motion; a memo becomes a site.
Neon lab - high-contrast gradients and playful motion; demo-day energy.

blocks.title: Where the prototype differs today
blocks.body: The brief names the modes Present and Read; this prototype ships them as Present and Browse. The brief makes theme choice an authoring concern; the prototype currently lets viewers audition all five themes. Both remain visible product questions.

blocks.title: Mode and theme rationale
blocks.body: One content tree feeds both reading and presentation shells. Theme tokens change appearance without changing content structure.

blocks.heading: Same file, two shells
blocks.body: Switching modes keeps the same section. That continuity is the product.
